title: Calibration of Large Model Quantization based on HiFloat4 Format
abstract: arXiv:2610.41112v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Quantization of Large Language Models (LLMs) has be- coming increasingly important for reducing the computa- tional costs and resource requirements for practical deploy- ment.Growinginterestinthisareahasmotivatedthecommu- nity to move beyond 8-bit quantization towards 4-bit preci- sion, leading to the development of customized 4-bit formats such as MXFP4 and NVFP4. Recently, HiFloat4 (HiF4) has emerged as a competitive alternative which adopts a Block Floating-Point(BFP)formatwithathree-levelscalinghierar- chy, thereby achieving a significantly larger dynamic range. While quantization can substantially reduce memory usage and accelerate inference, it frequently introduces accuracy degradation. Calibration is therefore essential for narrowing theperformancegapbetweenlow-precisionquantizedmodels and their full-precision counterparts. Nevertheless, existing calibration methods are mainly designed and validated us- ing integer-precision form

translated_title: 基于HiFloat4格式的大模型量化校准
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的量化对于降低实际部署中的计算成本和资源需求正变得越来越重要。该领域日益增长的关注度推动社区从8比特量化向4比特精度迈进，催生了MXFP4和NVFP4等定制化4比特格式。最近，HiFloat4（HiF4）作为一种具有竞争力的替代方案应运而生，它采用具有三级缩放层次的块浮点（BFP）格式，从而实现了显著更大的动态范围。虽然量化可以大幅减少内存占用并加速推理，但它常常会引入精度下降的问题。因此，校准对于缩小低精度量化模型与全精度模型之间的性能差距至关重要。然而，现有的校准方法主要是基于整数精度格式设计和验证的。
tldr: 该论文针对采用HiFloat4（HiF4）块浮点格式量化的4比特大语言模型提出校准方法，填补了现有校准技术仅针对整数精度格式设计而无法适配块浮点量化的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes calibration methods for 4-bit LLM quantization based on the HiFloat4 (HiF4) block floating-point format, addressing the gap that existing calibration approaches were designed and validated only for integer-precision formats.
